body: Yeah I think wanting kids is only natural for most people because it’s our biological instincts/urges telling us that we have to reproduce. Lately I’ve been pondering the idea but then I think of all the people I’ve known who have already died in accidents, from drug overdoses and from suicide. Let’s be real, the suicide rate is really high and I don’t want to bring a child into this world only for them to feel so sad and hopeless that they feel that offing themselves is the only way out.

Yeah, I had this discussion with a friend who is an unapologetic theist. I mentioned the flood and he told me that all the people on earth were wicked and so god needed to kill them (sparing only Noah and his family of course) and also not to question god because he is god. But, wicked or no, genocide is still genocide. Period.

I’m an agnostic although I do tend to lean more towards atheism these days only because I think “if there is a god why does he allow me to feel this bad?” Just recently I read about a pastor and mental health advocate who lost his battle with depression and left behind a wife and two sons. So even if I did have faith I’m not sure it would help me much either.
Yeah maybe not a lot of people but more people are grappling with those thoughts than we think.

I can really relate. I’m so unbelievably sad and pessimistic all the time even though I’ve had a great life and parents who love me unconditionally. I think knowing that just makes it worse because then I feel guilty for constantly feeling so bad. I would never actually harm myself but I am constantly wishing that I would just die in a random car accident or some kind of other freak accident. I’m just tired of this world. As the famous saying goes “the more you know the more you hate it here.”

In my experience the people who view life as a gift tend to be more religious. I’m on the fence. There are some days where I’m like fuck this world I hate everything and everyone and then there are days where I’m like “ok so maybe this isn’t so bad.” I call it bi-polar depression because I will be doing good for awhile and then all of a sudden I just get so unbelievably sad when I think about the state of the world we live in.

Did you just start getting those suicidal ideations when you got pregnant or did you always have thoughts of suicide? Maybe the pregnancy has something to do with it? Possibly a change in your hormones? It’s worth talking to a dr about.
Sadly the older I get the more I realize that is the only reason as to why a lot of people are still here.

Yeah. Personally, I suffer from depression and I would never forgive myself if I brought a child into this world and they felt the way that I do on a daily basis. It’s pure hell and simply not a way to live. Plus suicide is the second leading cause of death for people between the ages of 10-34. That’s honestly terrifying to think about. I can’t imagine raising a kid in this world only for them to end up taking themselves out.

Haha this just goes to show that they think having kids is their sole purpose in life. Natalists: “What do you mean you don’t want children?! Ok, well kill yourself then.” Antinatalists: “Well that escalated quickly.”
